columns.column_comment: 所属银行来源交易标识
最近核对结果发布时间
本轮账本查询成功标志
关联银行来源交易标识

constraints.definition: CHECK ((((task_type = ANY (ARRAY['sync'::text, 'sync_range'::text])) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NULL) AND (decision_version IS NULL) AND (status <> ALL (ARRAY['unknown'::text, 'rejected'::text]))) OR ((task_type = ANY (ARRAY['create'::text, 'settle_amount'::text, 'settle_currency'::text])) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) AND (decision_version IS NOT NULL) AND (decision_version > 0))))

CHECK (((report_type = 'monthly'::text) OR ((reconciliation_last_attempt_at IS NULL) AND (reconciled_at IS NULL) AND (reconciliation_next_check_at IS NULL) AND (reconciliation_input_fingerprint IS NULL) AND (reconciliation_queries_succeeded IS NULL) AND (reconciliation_last_error IS NULL) AND (reconciliation_version = 0))))
FOREIGN KEY (source_email_id, report_key) REFERENCES email(id, report_key) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED

CHECK ((((check_direction = 'statement_to_transaction'::text) AND (statement_row_key IS NOT NULL) AND (match_status = ANY (ARRAY['matched'::text, 'missing_source_transaction'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'out_of_scope'::text]))) OR ((check_direction = 'transaction_to_statement'::text) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) AND (match_status = ANY (ARRAY['matched'::text, 'missing_statement_evidence'::text, 'ambiguous'::text, 'awaiting_statement'::text])))))
CHECK (((check_direction <> 'statement_to_transaction'::text) OR (match_status <> ALL (ARRAY['ambiguous'::text, 'missing_source_transaction'::text])) OR (bank_transaction_id IS NULL)))

CHECK (((ledger_check_status <> ALL (ARRAY['query_failed'::text, 'not_checked'::text, 'target_missing'::text])) OR ((actual_amount IS NULL) AND (actual_currency IS NULL) AND (ledger_observed_at IS NULL))))
CHECK (((match_status <> 'matched'::text) OR ((statement_row_key IS NOT NULL) AND (bank_transaction_id IS NOT NULL))))

CHECK ((((accepted_at IS NULL) AND (acceptance_reason IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'collected'::text) AND (accepted_at IS NOT NULL) AND (acceptance_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM acceptance_reason)) > 0))))

CHECK ((((status = 'collected'::text) AND (email_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_status IS NOT NULL) AND (source_reason IS NOT NULL) AND (collected_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status <> 'collected'::text) AND (email_id IS NULL) AND (source_status IS NULL) AND (source_reason IS NULL) AND (collected_at IS NULL))))

indexes.indexdef: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_sync ON background_task USING btree (task_type) WHERE ((task_type = 'sync'::text) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'dispatching'::text])))

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX active_write ON background_task USING btree (bank_transaction_id) WHERE ((task_type = ANY (ARRAY['create'::text, 'settle_amount'::text, 'settle_currency'::text])) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['queued'::text, 'dispatching'::text, 'unknown'::text])))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX background_task_operation_key_key ON background_task USING btree (operation_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX background_task_pkey ON background_task USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bank_report_pkey ON bank_report USING btree (report_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bank_statement_reconciliation_pkey ON bank_statement_reconciliation USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX statement_object ON bank_statement_reconciliation USING btree (statement_report_key, statement_row_key) WHERE (check_direction = 'statement_to_transaction'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX transaction_object ON bank_statement_reconciliation USING btree (statement_report_key, bank_transaction_id) WHERE (check_direction = 'transaction_to_statement'::text)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bank_transactions_ledger_transaction_id_key ON bank_transactions USING btree (ledger_transaction_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bank_transactions_pkey ON bank_transactions USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bank_transactions_report_key_report_row_key_key ON bank_transactions USING btree (report_key, report_row_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bank_transactions_source_marker_key ON bank_transactions USING btree (source_marker)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX email_id_report_key_key ON email USING btree (id, report_key)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX email_pkey ON email USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX email_source_item_pkey ON email_source_item USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX email_source_item_source_id_folder_uid_validity_uid_key ON email_source_item USING btree (source_id, folder, uid_validity, uid)
CREATE INDEX pending_source_items ON email_source_item USING btree (source_id, folder, uid_validity, uid) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'failed'::text]))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX email_sync_checkpoint_pkey ON email_sync_checkpoint USING btree (source_id, folder)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ledger_write_attempt_pkey ON ledger_write_attempt USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schema_version_pkey ON schema_version USING btree (version)
